title: spec: type the remaining person-facing text slots as `template` slots — `confirmText` ×3, `successMessage` / `errorMessage` ×6, `emptyText` ×2 (ADR-0032 Decision 2 and 3; the same mechanism as #24798)
body:
Filing gate ③ — the maintainer's 「同意」 on the director's proposal 「另立一张 spec 卡把剩下九处文本槽统一改成 template 槽」 (director's chat, 2026-10-20), after 「是否建议统一到 cel」 was answered no: ADR-0032 keeps two shapes — whole-field CEL for logic and values, `{{ }}` templates for person-facing text — and what is not yet unified is the slot TYPE, not the dialect. Filed by the director seat (summon #45 continuation 1, `session_01Lg6GQ4xjqmvEzYv78d6H7i`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat, serial after #24798's spec PR (same mechanism: `TemplateExpressionInputSchema`, the bound-root judge at the three doors, the formatter whitelist). `Clause-②: yes` (widening), `minor`, contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; not before 18.0 GA. The renderer halves are objectui cards filed per slot family when the spec release is installable there (ruling D on #24591); the bulk-action one is objectstack-ai/objectui#13183.

Blocked-by: #24798

## Measured (objectstack `origin/main` `a43405d596d4`)

Template-typed today: the flow text slots (notify `title` / `message`, screen `title`, http `url` and headers — `automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts`), the AI prompt templates (`ai/model-registry.zod.ts:121–122`) and the deprecated `titleFormat` (`data/object.zod.ts:2843`). Still `z.string()` although person-facing text that carries holes by purpose:

| slot | where |
|:--|:--|
| `confirmText` | `ui/component.zod.ts:4036`, `:4136`, `:4286` (component action buttons; the bulk-action slot at `ui/bulk-action.zod.ts:403` is #24798) |
| `successMessage` / `errorMessage` | `ui/component.zod.ts:4037–4038`, `:4137–4138`, `:4287–4288` |
| `emptyText` | `ui/component.zod.ts:2477`, `:4717` |

Deliberately NOT in scope, literal by design: `title` (`ui/component.zod.ts:2252` 「Rendered as-is in EVERY locale」, `:2607`, `:5845`, `:5848`; `ui/chart.zod.ts:512`), `placeholder` and `helpText` (`ui/action.zod.ts:356`, `:358`; `ui/bulk-action.zod.ts:285`), a validation rule's `message` (`ui/component.zod.ts:6510`), diagnostic and error `message` fields in automation execution and bpmn interop. To confirm or exclude at claim: flow `successMessage` / `errorMessage` on `AutomationResult` (`automation/flow.zod.ts:1085–1086`), a result envelope rather than authored display text.

Every slot in scope is translated per locale where the i18n resolver reaches it (`system/i18n-resolver.ts:616`, `confirmText` and `successMessage`), which is why a template with named holes is the shape and a CEL expression is not: translators move holes, nobody translates an expression.

## What done looks like

Each listed slot is a `TemplateExpressionInputSchema` slot whose scope's bound roots are declared (the action's `record`, `count`, params — as each family has them); an unbound root or a single-brace token is refused by name at `objectstack validate`, `compile` and the publish gate through the flow text slots' judge; the example apps' authored strings still parse; artifacts regenerated. ⛔ No new engine, no new delimiter, no CEL inside holes. Producers measured at claim (`git grep` for each key carrying `{{`, examples and hotcrm).

## Dedupe

#24798 (the first member, ruled B); objectstack-ai/objectui#13154 (closed, moved). Open `domain:spec` cards scanned by title and body for template slot / `successMessage` / `emptyText` / `confirmText`: see the director's ledger block for the count read at filing; no card on typing these slots.
